_comment: Brand compliance rules from the Explore Asheville Storytelling Foundation. Enforced at build time and runtime for AI-generated content.

bannedContextual.context: Never use 'town' for Asheville. Black Mountain and Weaverville are towns.

required.city: Asheville is a city, not a town

tone.never: comparisons to other destinations in public-facing content

inRoomOnly.description: Content flagged inRoomOnly contains competitive rationale naming other destinations. Exclude from PDF export and any public-facing output.
